findings.title: Une réponse 401 retardée efface la session plus récente du même navigateur
findings.trigger: Une requête portant l’ancienne session A reste en attente dans une opération async; une reconnexion installe le cookie B dans le même navigateur; l’ancienne requête A reprend et échoue en 401 après révocation/expiration.
findings.impact: Le Set-Cookie de suppression, indexé seulement par le nom et le Path, efface B. La connexion qui vient de réussir est perdue. Affecte les deux rôles; peut également provoquer des redirections et perdre la continuité de saisie. Aucun contournement d’authentification ou accès à un tiers n’est démontré.
findings.cause: Le catch efface systématiquement le cookie de rôle à réception d’un 401 lié à la requête. Un serveur ne peut pas distinguer le cookie actuel du navigateur du cookie A reçu avant l’attente. Les protections frontend contre les réponses obsolètes n’empêchent pas le navigateur de traiter Set-Cookie.

repro.scenario: Actual chat/media/video/profile HTTP handlers, both roles; synthetic delayed service error. Replacement cookie modeled from actual Set-Cookie received over loopback. Privacy HTTP is the non-clearing negative control.

evidence: All eight chat/media/video/profile responses are 401 with a role-cookie Max-Age=0 header after the synthetic replacement cookie was received.
The privacy handler returns 401 without Set-Cookie and preserves the replacement in the same HTTP scheduling harness.
server/chat/client-export-http.mjs explicitly states a delayed request must never erase a newer client session cookie; server/privacy/http.mjs has the same rationale.
tests/chat-http.test.mjs:414–423 and tests/media-http.test.mjs:418–423 assert unconditional clearing on delayed service-401 errors, without the replacement-in-flight case.
Delivery reviewer verified auth/store.mjs:76–105 and access/store.mjs:347–365: asynchronous lookups/locks and clock refresh permit a revoked A to return null after a concurrent B has been issued.
Root counter-review confirmed the same late-cookie clearing in readiness/http.mjs:122 after readiness operations; this remains the same finding. This agent inspected lines114–126 directly.
findings.confidence: high for HTTP behavior and modeled cookie replacement; real-browser and hosted timing not exercised
findings.suggestedCorrection: Generalize the existing privacy/export rule to delayed authenticated responses; keep cookie destruction scoped to explicitly requested logout/session transitions and check their own concurrency semantics.
findings.regressionCoverageNeeded: Two-role replacement-in-flight cases on all affected handler families; ensure old 401 never emits a deletion cookie for B and still denies A.

testsRead.matches: authorization before storage, fresh permissions after quota

checks.result: 41/41 match the manifest; no source mutation
8 positives and 1 privacy negative control; script asserts expected headers and modeled cookie state
Message AAD binds sender/conversation/message; photo AES-GCM binds asset and variant; video authenticated header + indexed block AAD and per-file derived key reviewed
chat actor/conversation locks, refreshed session time, idempotent appends/tombstones, owner/media references, capacity reservation/commit/release and deletion intents reviewed
image worker isolation, bounded upload body/queue/time, video Range/HEAD/If-Range parsing, read slots, backpressure and cancellation cleanup reviewed
fixed entry names, ZIP32 sizes/CRC/descriptors, HTML escaping, reauthorization before headers and lazy opening of video deliveries, source wiping/close ownership reviewed
A01–A16 not re-counted. Existing growth/format/hosted-qualification limits retained.

nonFindings.hypothesis: Post-read authorization for every photo/video chunk
nonFindings.decision: Not counted: ordinary photo/video downloads authorize at opening; video code explicitly transfers immutable snapshot ownership and exports recheck unopened originals. No new documented immediate-cancellation guarantee or exploit beyond normal in-flight operation established. Avatar replacement has a stricter explicit second-check contract.

nonFindings.hypothesis: Bootstrap/client names incompatible with profile canonicalization
nonFindings.decision: Discarded after dependency review: registration and bootstrap normalize NFC and reject controls/Cf/outer whitespace before storing.

nonFindings.hypothesis: Video buffers wiped before HTTP socket consumption
nonFindings.decision: Discarded: video/storage.mjs:222–225 transfers successful buffer ownership without wiping; archive transport separately waits write callbacks before wiping its owned copies.

limits: Read-only audit; no repository fix or deployment performed.
No live account, real message, destructive action, hosted backup, email or production shell accessed.
No already-green general test suite rerun. Only the new scoped synthetic reproduction was executed.
Full source coverage applies to these 41 assigned files, not every repository test. testsRead distinguishes complete reads, ranges and searches honestly.
No MariaDB integration, real browser cookie jar or deployed Node v24.22.1 qualification executed; local Node v24.19.0 only.
Existing deliberate limits include original MP4 acceptance without codec/transcode guarantee, bounded exports/catalog growth and normal immutable in-flight reads.
No legal/privacy-compliance conclusion; user deferred that separate subject.
